actions_fence_check.name: actions_fence_check
actions_fence_check.value: "actions"."status" not in ('dispatching', 'uncertain') or ("actions"."fence_token" is not null and "actions"."submitted_at" is not null)

audience_themes_bounds.name: audience_themes_bounds
audience_themes_bounds.value:
length("audience_themes"."text") between 1 and 120 and cardinality("audience_themes"."phrases") <= 3
    and "audience_themes"."rooms" >= 0 and "audience_themes"."comments" >= 0 and "audience_themes"."audience_revision" >= 0

candidate_research_verdict_check.name: candidate_research_verdict_check
candidate_research_verdict_check.value: ("candidate_research"."verdict" is null and "candidate_research"."reason_code" is null and "candidate_research"."verified_by" is null) or ("candidate_research"."verdict" = 'confirmed' and "candidate_research"."reason_code" is null and "candidate_research"."verified_by" is not null) or ("candidate_research"."verdict" = 'rejected' and "candidate_research"."verified_by" is not null and ("candidate_research"."reason_code" is not null or "candidate_research"."verified_by" = 'owner'))

composer_drafts_values_check.name: composer_drafts_values_check
composer_drafts_values_check.value:
"composer_drafts"."position" >= 1 and "composer_drafts"."revision" >= 1
    and char_length("composer_drafts"."angle") between 1 and 24 and ("composer_drafts"."angle_why" is null or char_length("composer_drafts"."angle_why") <= 160)
    and "composer_drafts"."box_key" ~ '^(comment|reply|room|invite|dm|lead):.+'

composer_drafts_state_check.name: composer_drafts_state_check
composer_drafts_state_check.value:
("composer_drafts"."state" = 'ready' and "composer_drafts"."text" is not null)
    or ("composer_drafts"."state" in ('writing', 'idea') and "composer_drafts"."text" is null) or "composer_drafts"."state" = 'failed'

conversations_outcome_check.name: conversations_outcome_check
conversations_outcome_check.value: ("conversations"."outcome" is null and "conversations"."outcome_event_id" is null) or ("conversations"."outcome" in ('booked', 'activated', 'paid') and "conversations"."outcome_event_id" is not null)

conversations_closed_check.name: conversations_closed_check
conversations_closed_check.value: ("conversations"."closed_reason" is null and "conversations"."closed_at" is null) or ("conversations"."closed_reason" in ('opt_out', 'manual_exclude', 'reopened') and "conversations"."closed_at" is not null)

draft_attempts_values_check.name: draft_attempts_values_check
draft_attempts_values_check.value:
"draft_attempts"."attempt" between 1 and 2
    and "draft_attempts"."outcome" in ('admitted', 'rewrite', 'withheld', 'held', 'discarded')
    and ("draft_attempts"."outcome" in ('admitted', 'held') or "draft_attempts"."reason" is not null)

email_delivery_receipts_lifecycle_chk.name: email_delivery_receipts_lifecycle_chk
email_delivery_receipts_lifecycle_chk.value:
(
        "email_delivery_receipts"."state" = 'reserved'
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."attempts" = 0
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."recipient_user_id" is not null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."encrypted_provider_payload" is not null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."first_attempt_at" is null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."last_attempt_at" is null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."sent_at" is null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."provider_message_id" is null
      ) or (
        "email_delivery_receipts"."state" = 'sending'
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."attempts" > 0
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."recipient_user_id" is not null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."encrypted_provider_payload" is not null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."first_attempt_at" is not null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."last_attempt_at" is not null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."sent_at" is null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."provider_message_id" is null
      ) or (
        "email_delivery_receipts"."state" = 'sent'
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."attempts" > 0
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."encrypted_provider_payload" is null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."first_attempt_at" is not null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."last_attempt_at" is not null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."sent_at" is not null
      ) or (
        "email_delivery_receipts"."state" = 'uncertain'
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."encrypted_provider_payload" is null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."sent_at" is null
        and "email_delivery_receipts"."provider_message_id" is null
        and (
          (
            "email_delivery_receipts"."attempts" = 0
            and "email_delivery_receipts"."first_attempt_at" is null
            and "email_delivery_receipts"."last_attempt_at" is null
          ) or (
            "email_delivery_receipts"."attempts" > 0
            and "email_delivery_receipts"."first_attempt_at" is not null
            and "email_delivery_receipts"."last_attempt_at" is not null
          )
        )
      )

inbox_reads_outcome_check.name: inbox_reads_outcome_check
inbox_reads_outcome_check.value: "inbox_reads"."outcome" in ('read', 'refused', 'failed') and ("inbox_reads"."outcome" = 'read' or "inbox_reads"."reason" is not null)

incoming_comments_source_links_check.name: incoming_comments_source_links_check
incoming_comments_source_links_check.value: ("incoming_comments"."source" = 'own_post' and "incoming_comments"."discovered_post_id" is null and "incoming_comments"."parent_message_id" is null) or ("incoming_comments"."source" = 'our_comment_thread' and "incoming_comments"."parent_message_id" is not null)

incoming_comments_draft_request_metadata.name: incoming_comments_draft_request_metadata_check
incoming_comments_draft_request_metadata.value: ("incoming_comments"."draft_request_id" is null and "incoming_comments"."draft_requested_at" is null and "incoming_comments"."draft_requested_by" is null) or ("incoming_comments"."draft_request_id" is not null and "incoming_comments"."draft_requested_at" is not null and "incoming_comments"."draft_requested_by" is not null)

incoming_invitations_attribution_check.name: incoming_invitations_attribution_check
incoming_invitations_attribution_check.value: ("incoming_invitations"."attribution" = 'unmatched' and "incoming_invitations"."conversation_id" is null and "incoming_invitations"."conversation_event_id" is null) or ("incoming_invitations"."attribution" in ('verified_exchange', 'user_confirmed_link') and "incoming_invitations"."conversation_id" is not null and "incoming_invitations"."conversation_event_id" is not null)

lead_signals_values_check.name: lead_signals_values_check
lead_signals_values_check.value:
"lead_signals"."person_key" ~ '^[pm][.]'
        and "lead_signals"."kind" in ('post', 'comment') and ("lead_signals"."kind" = 'comment') = ("lead_signals"."comment_urn" is not null)
        and ("lead_signals"."language_type" is null or "lead_signals"."language_type" in ('pain', 'desired_outcome', 'failed_alternative', 'comparison', 'direct_ask'))
        and "lead_signals"."verdict" in ('pending', 'passed', 'dropped', 'expired', 'unscreenable')
        and ("lead_signals"."role" is null or "lead_signals"."role" in ('buyer', 'peer', 'competitor', 'partner', 'noise'))
        and ("lead_signals"."drop_reason" is null or "lead_signals"."drop_reason" in ('no_own_words', 'not_audience', 'selling_similar', 'already_solved', 'recruiter', 'student'))
        and ("lead_signals"."verdict" = 'dropped') = ("lead_signals"."drop_reason" is not null)

leads_intent_quote_check.name: leads_intent_quote_check
leads_intent_quote_check.value:
"leads"."intent" is null or "leads"."intent" = 'topic_only'
        or (char_length(btrim(coalesce("leads"."intent_quote", ''))) > 0 and "leads"."intent_at" is not null)

leads_rating_check.name: leads_rating_check
leads_rating_check.value:
("leads"."rating" is null or "leads"."rating" in ('right_person', 'a_peer', 'not_a_fit', 'wrong_intent'))
        and ("leads"."rating" is null) = ("leads"."rated_at" is null)

leads_set_aside_check.name: leads_set_aside_check
leads_set_aside_check.value:
("leads"."set_aside_reason" is null or "leads"."set_aside_reason" in ('owner', 'not_a_fit', 'a_peer'))
        and ("leads"."set_aside_reason" is null) = ("leads"."set_aside_at" is null)

license_seats_revocation_pair_check.name: license_seats_revocation_pair_check
license_seats_revocation_pair_check.value: ("license_seats"."revoked_at" is null and "license_seats"."revoked_reason" is null) or ("license_seats"."revoked_at" is not null and "license_seats"."revoked_reason" is not null)

live_checks_writing_check.name: live_checks_writing_check
live_checks_writing_check.value:
"live_checks"."state" not in ('writing', 'recorded') or ("live_checks"."read_confirmed_at" is not null and
        (("live_checks"."capability" <> 'room_reply' and "live_checks"."action_execution_id" is not null and "live_checks"."message_id" is null)
          or ("live_checks"."capability" = 'room_reply' and "live_checks"."message_id" is not null and "live_checks"."action_execution_id" is null)))

live_checks_recorded_check.name: live_checks_recorded_check
live_checks_recorded_check.value: "live_checks"."state" <> 'recorded' or ("live_checks"."recorded_at" is not null and "live_checks"."recorded_by" is not null and "live_checks"."write_proof" is not null)

live_checks_cleared_check.name: live_checks_cleared_check
live_checks_cleared_check.value: ("live_checks"."cleared_at" is null) = ("live_checks"."cleared_by" is null) and ("live_checks"."cleared_at" is null or "live_checks"."recorded_at" is not null)

message_draft_revisions_request_metadata.name: message_draft_revisions_request_metadata_check
message_draft_revisions_request_metadata.value: ("message_draft_revisions"."request_id" is null and "message_draft_revisions"."request_version" is null and "message_draft_revisions"."requested_at" is null and "message_draft_revisions"."requested_by" is null) or ("message_draft_revisions"."request_id" is not null and "message_draft_revisions"."request_version" is not null and "message_draft_revisions"."request_version" >= 0 and "message_draft_revisions"."requested_at" is not null and "message_draft_revisions"."requested_by" is not null)

messages_posting_marker_check.name: messages_posting_marker_check
messages_posting_marker_check.value: ("messages"."status" = 'posting' and "messages"."posting_started_at" is not null) or ("messages"."status" <> 'posting' and "messages"."posting_started_at" is null)

messages_target_kind_check.name: messages_target_kind_check
messages_target_kind_check.value:
("messages"."kind" = 'comment' and "messages"."incoming_comment_id" is null and "messages"."room_reply_target" is null)
        or ("messages"."kind" = 'reply' and "messages"."discovered_post_id" is null and "messages"."room_reply_target" is null)
        or ("messages"."kind" = 'room_reply' and "messages"."incoming_comment_id" is null and "messages"."room_reply_target" is not null
          and jsonb_typeof("messages"."room_reply_target") = 'object')

messages_redraft_request_metadata_check.name: messages_redraft_request_metadata_check
messages_redraft_request_metadata_check.value: ("messages"."redraft_request_id" is null and "messages"."redraft_requested_at" is null and "messages"."redraft_requested_by" is null) or ("messages"."redraft_request_id" is not null and "messages"."redraft_requested_at" is not null and "messages"."redraft_requested_by" is not null)

organizations_onboarding_execution_mode_.name: organizations_onboarding_execution_mode_check
organizations_onboarding_execution_mode_.value: ("organizations"."onboarding_execution_mode" is null and "organizations"."onboarding_first_run_choice" is null and "organizations"."onboarding_host_approval_state" is null) or ("organizations"."onboarding_execution_mode" = 'manual' and "organizations"."onboarding_first_run_choice" = 'manual' and "organizations"."onboarding_host_approval_state" is null) or ("organizations"."onboarding_execution_mode" = 'scheduled' and ("organizations"."onboarding_first_run_choice" is null or "organizations"."onboarding_first_run_choice" in ('run_now', 'next_schedule')) and ("organizations"."onboarding_host_approval_state" is null or "organizations"."onboarding_host_approval_state" in ('pending', 'enabled', 'declined', 'unsupported')))

outcome_events_attribution_check.name: outcome_events_attribution_check
outcome_events_attribution_check.value: ("outcome_events"."attribution_method" = 'unknown' and "outcome_events"."conversation_id" is null and "outcome_events"."author_profile_id" is null) or ("outcome_events"."attribution_method" in ('user_confirmed', 'consented_identifier') and "outcome_events"."conversation_id" is not null and "outcome_events"."author_profile_id" is not null)

outcome_events_reversal_check.name: outcome_events_reversal_check
outcome_events_reversal_check.value: "outcome_events"."type" not in ('cancelled', 'refunded') or "outcome_events"."supersedes_event_id" is not null

room_reply_drafts_values_check.name: room_reply_drafts_values_check
room_reply_drafts_values_check.value:
"room_reply_drafts"."revision" >= 0 and "room_reply_drafts"."authorship" in ('unknown', 'owner', 'assisted')
    and ("room_reply_drafts"."assist_retention" is null or "room_reply_drafts"."assist_retention" between 0 and 1)
    and ("room_reply_drafts"."owner_origin" is null or "room_reply_drafts"."owner_origin" between 0 and 1)

room_snapshots_bounds.name: room_snapshots_bounds
room_snapshots_bounds.value: "room_snapshots"."pages" between 1 and 2 and "room_snapshots"."comments_read" between 0 and 100 and "room_snapshots"."total_comments" >= 0

search_changes_values_check.name: search_changes_values_check
search_changes_values_check.value:
"search_changes"."actor" in ('scout', 'owner')
        and "search_changes"."action" in ('add', 'retire', 'restore', 'pin', 'unpin', 'edit', 'refused')
        and ("search_changes"."action" = 'refused') = ("search_changes"."refusal" is not null)

search_lookalikes_bounds.name: search_lookalikes_bounds
search_lookalikes_bounds.value:
"search_lookalikes"."audience_revision" >= 0 and "search_lookalikes"."comments" >= 0 and "search_lookalikes"."judged" >= 0
    and "search_lookalikes"."fits" between 0 and "search_lookalikes"."judged" and length("search_lookalikes"."opening") <= 280 and jsonb_array_length("search_lookalikes"."proposals") <= 4

searches_values_check.name: searches_values_check
searches_values_check.value:
"searches"."lane" in ('keywords', 'creators', 'competitors', 'one_thread')
        and ("searches"."language_type" is null or "searches"."language_type" in ('pain', 'desired_outcome', 'failed_alternative', 'comparison', 'direct_ask'))
        and "searches"."origin" in ('pains', 'scout', 'owner', 'like_a_post')
        and ("searches"."source_role" is null or "searches"."source_role" in ('peer', 'competitor'))
        and "searches"."status" in ('active', 'parked', 'retired')
        and ("searches"."retired_by" is null or "searches"."retired_by" in ('scout', 'owner'))
        and "searches"."sort" in ('relevance', 'latest')
        and "searches"."date_posted" in ('past_day', 'past_week', 'past_month')
        and "searches"."buyers" >= 0 and "searches"."peers" >= 0 and "searches"."noise" >= 0

searches_language_type_check.name: searches_language_type_check
searches_language_type_check.value:
case when "searches"."lane" = 'keywords'
        then "searches"."origin" = 'like_a_post' or "searches"."language_type" is not null
        else "searches"."language_type" is null end

searches_retired_check.name: searches_retired_check
searches_retired_check.value:
("searches"."retired_at" is null) = ("searches"."retired_by" is null)
        and ("searches"."retired_at" is not null) = ("searches"."status" = 'retired')

subscriptions_guarded_cancellation_pair_.name: subscriptions_guarded_cancellation_pair_check
subscriptions_guarded_cancellation_pair_.value: ("subscriptions"."guarded_cancellation_token" is null and "subscriptions"."guarded_cancellation_started_at" is null and "subscriptions"."guarded_cancellation_requested_by_user_id" is null) or ("subscriptions"."guarded_cancellation_token" is not null and "subscriptions"."guarded_cancellation_started_at" is not null)

supervision_state_check.name: supervision_state_check
supervision_state_check.value:
"supervision_state"."restart_count" >= 0
        and ("supervision_state"."holder_id" is null) = ("supervision_state"."holder_lease_until" is null)
        and ("supervision_state"."state" <> 'backoff' or "supervision_state"."backoff_until" is not null)

transfer_intents_activation_pair_check.name: transfer_intents_activation_pair_check
transfer_intents_activation_pair_check.value: ("transfer_intents"."activated_epoch" is null and "transfer_intents"."activated_at" is null) or ("transfer_intents"."activated_epoch" is not null and "transfer_intents"."activated_at" is not null and "transfer_intents"."state" = 'activated')

worker_runs_lead_counts_check.name: worker_runs_lead_counts_check
worker_runs_lead_counts_check.value:
"worker_runs"."lead_read_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_found_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_screened_in_count" >= 0
        and "worker_runs"."lead_researched_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_research_deferred_count" >= 0
        and "worker_runs"."lead_served_asking_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_served_problem_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_served_topic_count" >= 0
        and "worker_runs"."lead_merged_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_drop_no_words_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_drop_not_audience_count" >= 0
        and "worker_runs"."lead_drop_selling_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_drop_solved_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_drop_recruiter_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_drop_student_count" >= 0
        and "worker_runs"."lead_buyer_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_not_fit_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."lead_peer_count" >= 0
        and "worker_runs"."lead_partner_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."search_pages_count" >= 0 and "worker_runs"."thread_reads_count" >= 0
        and "worker_runs"."profile_reads_count" >= 0

workers_enabled_does_something_check.name: workers_enabled_does_something_check
workers_enabled_does_something_check.value:
not "workers"."enabled"
        or ("workers"."kind" = 'scout' and "workers"."sweep_enabled")
        or ("workers"."kind" = 'ambassador' and ("workers"."draft_enabled" or "workers"."conversation_enabled"))
